runs.title: Job runs
runs.emptyDescription: Runs appear here as the server works.

outbox.title: Message queue
outbox.intro: Messages waiting to be delivered in the background. A message that used all its tries is dead-lettered. The content of a message is never shown here.
outbox.typeHint: A name or the start of one, for example order.
outbox.requeuedOne: The message is back in line.
outbox.confirmOne: The message goes back to waiting with its attempts set to 0 and the server tries to deliver it again right away, with the usual retries. Delivery is safe to repeat.
outbox.confirmBulk: Each message goes back to waiting with its attempts set to 0 and is delivered again with the usual retries. A message that is not dead-lettered or retrying is skipped, and you will see the reason for each one afterwards.
outbox.emptyDescription: The queue has no waiting, retrying or dead-lettered messages.

failed.title: Failed sends
failed.intro: SMS, e-mail and WhatsApp messages that could not be sent. The recipient is masked and the text is not shown.
failed.retriedOne: The message was queued to send again.
failed.confirmOne: The message goes back to pending with its attempts set to 0 and one new delivery is queued. The text and the customer consent that were fixed when it was written are not checked again.
failed.confirmBulk: Each message goes back to pending and one new delivery is queued for it. A message that is no longer failed is skipped, and you will see the reason for each one afterwards.
failed.emptyDescription: No SMS, e-mail or WhatsApp message is waiting for a retry.

health.subtitle: Is each outside service working? Payment gateways, couriers, SMS, e-mail and WhatsApp, plus the state of this server.
health.autoRefresh: Refreshes by itself every 30 seconds while this tab is open.
health.memoryNote: Health is recorded by this server process only. It starts empty after a restart, so a service nobody has called yet shows that no calls are recorded, not Healthy.
